meta.title: Campus recruitment calendar
meta.description: Application windows for graduate programmes, copied from each employer's official page, with the source link and the date we last checked it.
meta.companyDescription: {company} graduate programmes and application dates, from the official page, with the source link and the date we last checked it.

page.title: Campus recruitment calendar
page.sub: Application windows from employers' official pages. Every entry links to its source and shows when staff last checked it.
page.honesty: Dates are copied from the official page. Confirm them on the employer's site before you apply.
page.unavailableTitle: The campus calendar isn't available here
page.unavailableSub: It may not be offered on this site yet.

list.label: Programmes
list.emptySub: Programmes appear here after staff check them against the employer's official page.

event.sourceAria: Source page: {source} (opens in a new tab)
event.officialPageAria: Official page of {company} (opens in a new tab)
event.needsCheckHint: Not checked in the last 14 days. Confirm the dates on the official page.
event.applyAria: Apply on {company}'s site (opens in a new tab)

remind.hint: Reminders go out 3 days and 1 day before applications close.
remind.noDate: No close date to remind you about
remind.error: We couldn't save the reminder. Try again.

follow.title: Follow {company}
follow.sub: Get a message in your inbox when {company} posts a programme for your class.
follow.error: We couldn't save that. Try again.

company.title: {company} campus programmes
company.sub: Programmes from the official page, with the date staff last checked each one.

admin.title: Campus calendar entries
admin.sub: Add programmes from employers' official pages only. Check every field against the page, then publish.
admin.notAdmin: Only staff can edit the campus calendar.

extract.title: Start from an official page
extract.sub: Paste the employer's own campus page. One page is read; the fields below are a suggestion until you check them.
extract.aiNote: Suggested by AI from the page. Check each field against the page before saving.
extract.dropped: Not filled because the page doesn't state it: {fields}

errors.aggregator_source: That site lists other employers' programmes. Use the employer's own page.
errors.not_a_web_address: That isn't a public web address.
errors.page_unreachable: The page couldn't be read. Fill in the fields by hand from the page.
errors.extract_failed: The page couldn't be read automatically. Fill in the fields by hand from the page.
errors.ai_unavailable: Reading pages with AI is off on this server. Fill in the fields by hand.
errors.apply_window_inverted: The close date is before the open date.
errors.campus_event_not_verified: Check this entry against the official page before publishing.

form.title: Programme name
form.sourceUrl: Source URL (only if not the official page)
form.editClearsCheck: Changing a fact clears the last check; a published entry goes back to draft until it's checked again.

item.verify: I checked it against the official page
item.confirmArchive: Archive this programme? It comes off the calendar and can't be published again.
item.confirmDelete: Delete this draft? This can't be undone.
